liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Blues For Allah** (2 reviews): Concert ends with Blues for Allah, though text file lists it later; Blues For Allah is described as a plus version with extra songs [5][13]
- **Help On The Way** (1 review): Starts a little loose on Help On the Way since the material was new [13]
- **Slipknot** (1 review): Band pulls it together by Slipknot! and jams from then on [13]
- **Crazy Fingers** (1 review): Crazy Fingers into Drums is the listener's favorite transition of all time [14]

## The recordings

- **gd75-08-13.fm.vernon.23661.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 18 songs; 122 min; rated 4.85/5 by 67 [1]. Said about its sound: Excellent quality; Roses and Eyes of the World share Disk 1, Track 6; Raw feel with Phil sounding wonderful, though the mix is a bit flatter; FM sounds nice and crispy with Phil mixed real nice, standing tall [5][7][11][15]
- **gd1975-08-13.fm.cousinit.18512.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 120 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [2]
- **gd1975-08-13.155570.FM.flegel.flac1644**: FM broadcast; 17 songs; 123 min; rated 3/5 by 3 [3]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: Bill Graham [1]
- Energy runs throughout the dance floor and balconies at this venue [12]
- Phil jammed Franklin's Tower with Umphrey's McGee at this venue [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd75-08-13.fm.vernon.23661.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard - FM [1]. Also: Pitch-corrected FM broadcast originally seeded by CousinIt, transferred by Matt Vernon; Taped off the board onto 16-track Ampex, then made digital [1][15]
- **gd1975-08-13.fm.cousinit.18512.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by C>SHN Conversions by Cousinit; source: FM Source: SBD>FM>MC>DAT>WAV>SHN SBD Source: MSR>R(2)>C>DAT>WAV>SHN [2]. Also: FM broadcast aired on Metromedia Network September 1, 1975, normalized via SoundForge [2]
- **gd1975-08-13.155570.FM.flegel.flac1644**: taped by Brian Flegel; transferred by Brian Flegel; source: (Bootleg Tape - from FM broadcast - 9/1/75) [3]. Also: Burned from cassette using 1989 TC-WE475 deck and 2001 Sony burner, pitch corrected [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by lostlivedead.blogspot.com: [August 13, 1975: Great American Music Hall, 859 O'Farrell Street, San Francisco, CA (FM IX)](https://lostlivedead.blogspot.com/2014/08/august-13-1975-great-american-music.html) [17]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Great American Music Hall - August 13, 1975](https://www.dead.net/show/august-13-1975) [18]
- Poster by lostlivedead.blogspot.com: [August 13, 1975: Great American Music Hall, 859 O'Farrell Street, San Francisco, CA (FM IX)](https://lostlivedead.blogspot.com/2014/08/august-13-1975-great-american-music.html) [19]
